**What was produced:**
- `index.md` — 7-min read, 22 cited sources, `md` format (text-heavy survey)
- `citations.jsonl` — 22 entries, all peer-reviewed or primary sources
- `cover.svg` — red/green/refactor ring + AI hub, rust palette

**Key findings captured:**
- Productivity paradox: 55.8% faster on toy tasks (Copilot RCT) vs 19% slower on real complex work (METR 2025, n=246 tasks)
- LLM test generators are architecturally broken for bug-finding — CoverAgent/CoverUp filter out failing tests by design (arXiv 2412.14137)
- Without seed tests, Copilot's `/tests` produces 92.45% broken/empty output
- TDAD (Mar 2026): graph-based impact analysis cuts regressions 70%; naive TDD procedure instructions *worsen* agent regressions to 9.94%
- MuTAP mutation-augmented prompting: 93.57% mutation score vs ~40% vanilla
- Core constraint that makes the loop work: *"you may not modify the test file"*
